status: IMPLEMENTED; standalone and integrated installed-Chrome walking animation visually reviewed; owner final art approval pending

processing.tools: Existing @gltf-transform 4.5.1 and meshoptimizer dependencies; no downloaded executable scripts
steps: Decode EXT_meshopt_compression and dequantize geometry offline, avoiding a remote runtime decoder.
Copy matching female/male MIT walk animation accessors onto the model Bip01 skeleton by exact bone name.
Preserve embedded Microsoft MIT copyright and full license text in each GLB; ship the original upstream MIT notice.
Preserve original embedded WebP garment, skin and hair textures; use nonmetal cloth/skin PBR parameters.

At runtime sample the skeletal clip into a shared 60-frame GPU matrix texture once per variant, without rendering or advancing simulation. Native instances select frames only from simulation-time gait.
Normalize each animation frame to the planted shoe height; keep rounded walking patrols inside sidewalks, away from road junctions.
